raw_market.description:
In the first half of the NFL game between Vikings and Saints, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Saints score 18 or more points in the first half.

If the Saints score less than 18 points in the first half, this market will resolve to "Under".

This market is based solely on the Saints's first half score.

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
